```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(raster)
library(leaflet)
library(shiny)
library(tmap)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)

t_crs<-"+proj=aea +lat_1=-9 +lat_2=-26 +lat_0=-17 +lon_0=180 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"
```

# Fiji basins/Fiji outline

```{r}
fiji_basins12<-st_read(here("projected_data/Basins/Fiji_basins12.shp")) %>% 
  filter(!MAIN_BAS %in% c(5120082250)) 

fiji_basins<-st_transform(fiji_basins12, t_crs) %>% 
  dplyr::select(MAIN_BAS, area_km2) %>% 
  group_by(MAIN_BAS) %>% 
  summarise(total_area = sum(area_km2, na.rm = T))
```

# Unconnected

```{r}
septic<-st_read(here("output_data/Nutrients_at_pourpoints/Fiji_septic_pourpoints.shp")) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-geometry) %>% 
  group_by(MAIN_BA) %>% 
  summarise(total_N_tonnes = sum(N, na.rm = T)*0.001,
            total_P_tonnes = sum(P, na.rm = T)*0.001) %>% 
  rename(MAIN_BAS = MAIN_BA)
```

```{r}
direct<-st_read(here("output_data/Nutrients_at_pourpoints/Fiji_direct_pourpoints.shp")) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-geometry) %>% 
  group_by(MAIN_BA) %>% 
  summarise(total_N_tonnes = sum(N, na.rm = T)*0.001,
            total_P_tonnes = sum(P, na.rm = T)*0.001) %>% 
  rename(MAIN_BAS = MAIN_BA)
```
# Combine with basin shapefile

```{r}
septic_nutri_basin<-full_join(fiji_basins, septic, by = "MAIN_BAS")

septic_nutri_basin2<-septic_nutri_basin %>% 
  mutate(total_N_tonnes = as.numeric(total_N_tonnes),
         total_N_tonnes = ifelse(is.na(total_N_tonnes) == T, 0, as.numeric(total_N_tonnes)))
```

```{r}
direct_nutri_basin<-full_join(fiji_basins, direct, by = "MAIN_BAS")

direct_nutri_basin2<-direct_nutri_basin %>% 
  mutate(total_N_tonnes = as.numeric(total_N_tonnes),
         total_N_tonnes = ifelse(is.na(total_N_tonnes) == T, 0, as.numeric(total_N_tonnes)))
```


# Plot
```{r}
septic_nutri<-tm_shape(septic_nutri_basin2) +
    tm_polygons(col = "total_N_tonnes",
                style = "cont",
                title = "Nitrogen\n(tonnes)") +
  tm_layout(title = "Septic") 

septic_nutri
```

```{r}
direct_nutri<-tm_shape(direct_nutri_basin2) +
    tm_polygons(col = "total_N_tonnes",
                style = "cont",
                title = "Nitrogen\n(tonnes)") +
  tm_layout(title = "Direct") 

direct_nutri
```

# Connected

```{r}
connected<-st_read(here("output_data/Nutrients_at_pourpoints/Fiji_connected_pourpoints.shp")) %>% 
  mutate(N_tonnes = N_final*0.001)
```
```{r}
basins_diss<-fiji_basins %>% 
  mutate(ID = as.numeric(1)) %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  summarise(total_area_km2 = sum(total_area, na.rm = T))
```


```{r}
connected_nutri_plot<-tm_shape(basins_diss) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_shape(connected)+
  tm_bubbles(col = "N_tonnes",
             style = "cont",
             size = 0.5,
             border.col = "black", 
             border.lwd = 2, 
             title.shape = "Nitrogen\n(tonnes)", 
             title.col = "Nitrogen\n(tonnes)") +
  tm_layout(title = "Connected") #+
  #tm_text("label", size = 1, auto.placement = 1.5, col = "darkblue")

connected_nutri_plot
```
# Tourism

```{r}
tourist<-read.csv(here("output_data/Tourism/Treated_tourist_nutrients.csv")) %>% 
  group_by(MAIN_BAS) %>% 
  summarise(total_N_tonnes = sum(Treated_N, na.rm = T)*0.001,
            total_P_tonnes = sum(Treated_P, na.rm = T)*0.001)
```

```{r}
basin_tourism<-full_join(fiji_basins, tourist, by = "MAIN_BAS")
```

```{r}
tourism_nutri<-tm_shape(basin_tourism) +
    tm_polygons(col = "total_N_tonnes",
                style = "cont",
                title = "Nitrogen\n(tonnes)") +
  tm_layout(title = "Tourism") 

tourism_nutri
```
# All together

```{r}
nutri_final<-tmap_arrange(direct_nutri, septic_nutri, connected_nutri_plot, tourism_nutri, nrow = 1)

nutri_final
```

```{r}
tmap_save(nutri_final, here("figures/Nutrient_treatment_map.png"), dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 5)
```
